programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2609
programme.desc: 25 år gamle Lina fra Dalarna har nettopp blitt mor for første gang, og ønsker nå en gang for alle å få orden på økonomien.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2610
programme.desc: Niklas fra Dalarna jobber som vei-maler og tjener gode penger. Men interessen hans for biler og lån har satt ham i en situasjon hvor han nå risikerer å miste ALT.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2611
programme.desc: Martin fra Gislaved elsker dingser. Klarna-kontoen hans overstiger 76 000 svenske kroner, og dette er bare ett av syv dyre kredittlån han har. Han er også i ferd med å miste sin kjæreste.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2612
programme.desc: Småbarnsfaren Micael fra Örebro drikker rundt 1000 liter kaffe i året og bruker nesten 30.000 svenske kroner på energidrikker hvert år. Han drømmer også om å ha råd til å ta med barna på ferie.

programme.title: Luksusfellen Sverige: Episode 2613
programme.desc: Susanne og Andreas bor i Timrå med sine tre barn. Ekteskapet holder på å rakne, men i stedet for å lete etter jobb, spiller Andreas dyre mobilspill flere timer om dagen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 308
programme.desc: Julia forteller om hvordan hun takler slemme kommentarer på sosiale medier. Hun får mange fine kommentarer, men det er også de som tror hun lever på Milans funksjonshemming.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 309
programme.desc: Natalie og barna drar ut i skogen for å plukke sopp, men blir tvunget til å snu når de innser at det er elgjakt. Julia snakker om graviditeten og om at hun har lyst til å bli gravid igjen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 310
programme.desc: Fayme forteller om depresjonen etter fødselen og Colin og Leo klipper seg hos frisøren. Julia og Milan drar hjem til Julias venn for å hilse på de nye kattungene hennes.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 311
programme.desc: Milan hater å gå til tannlegen, og Julia er forberedt på det verste før dagens besøk. Fayme og Colin baker kake til Leos fest. Når kaken nesten er ferdig, nyser Colin over hele kaken.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 312

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 313
programme.desc: Milan og Julia er i Stockholm for å bli fotografert for magasinet MAMA. Tindra har fylt en måned og feires med kaffe og kaker.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 314
programme.desc: Fayme har blitt diagnostisert med GAD, en angstlidelse. Hun er lettet over å ha endelig fått en diagnose og snakker om hvordan det er å leve med den.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Episode 315

programme.desc: Tindra og Linn prøver babymassasje for å kurere Tindras kolikk. Natalie og Joline har besøkt logopeden for å utvikle Jolines talespråk.

programme.title: Dead Again

programme.title: Elizabethtown

programme.title: Falling In Love
programme.desc: Frank og Molly møtes under julehandelen. Dette korte øyeblikket vil forandre livene deres, når de gjenkjenner hverandre på toget hjem måneder senere og har en fin tid sammen.

programme.title: Like Crazy
programme.desc: En britisk student faller for en amerikansk student, bare for å bli skilt fra ham når hun blir utvist fra USA etter å ha overskredet oppholdstillatelsen sin.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: En astronomiprofessor med NASA-bakgrunn gjør en skremmende oppdagelse om at en destruktiv asteroide er på kollisjonskurs med jorda, og han må få familien i trygghet mens han varsler verden om den kommende ødeleggelsen.

programme.title: The Fountain

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right

programme.desc: Bryson får den ikke opp og passerer de akseptable grensene for mannlig intimitet når han prøver å snakke om det hos barbereren; Ari vurderer grensene for hans seksualitet og maskulinitet, og utfordrer hans selvfølelse.

programme.title: Boomerang: Day Weekend
programme.desc: Simone samler gjengen og særskilte andre på farens luksusstrandhus. Det skulle føre alle sammen, men slutter med å vise hvordan alle har forandret seg og muligens vokst fra hverandre.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom
programme.desc: Mary Jane lover på å nyte en angstfri helg, men planen skjærer seg når Mark ber henne om hjelp med foreldrene som er på besøk. Åpenbaringer tvinger Mark til å forandre.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mary Jane Knows Best
programme.desc: Da Mary Janes affære ble avslørt, tvinges hun til å innse at hun er mer hekta enn hun trodde. Patricks nykterhetsfest gir et bilde av den mannen han engang var.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Sleepless In Atlanta
programme.desc: Kara vil beskytte Mary Jane fra resultatet av en fokusgruppe, Niecy prøver å verne seg seg og Treyvion for faren hans, som uventet dukker opp fra college. Patrick prøver å balansere arbeid og familie, og Mary Jane treffer Sheldon.

programme.title: Twenties: The Pilot
programme.desc: Den ambisiøse manusforfatteren Hattie finner seg kastet ut, arbeidsløs og ulykkelig. Så løper hun på den berømte forfatteren og produsenten Ida B, hvis serie Cocoa's Butter Hattie has fulgt i sosiale medier.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-eksperten Friar finner en bombe festet til stolen sin, og en hacker beordrer ham til å stjele digitale penger. Snart må Friar kjempe for å renvaske navnet sitt - uten å bli sprengt i fillebiter.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den avdankede sheriffen i en liten by i Georgia, Ben Watts, blir presset til raskt å løse en gisselsituasjon – og innser snart at han er en brikke i et større spill blant byens skumle hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En kompromissløs mestertyv blir forrådt av medhjelperne og overlatt for å dø. Han utgir seg for å være en annen og samarbeider med en kvinne på innsiden for å sikre seg det seneste kuppet til gjengen.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Animal Instincts
programme.desc: The first pump action shotgun - a Winchester Model 1897; a hunter's collection of prize big game, full-body taxidermy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Miami Heat

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.desc: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: What Happens In Vegas
programme.desc: Etter en ekstremt fuktig kveld på byen våkner to svært forskjellige fremmede opp på et hotellrom. Jack og Joy har begge fått en ektefelle og masse penger de ikke hadde dagen før! Med Ashton Kutcher og Cameron Diaz.

programme.title: Upside of Anger

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Hitler's Inside Man
programme.desc: Chaim Rumkowski, leader of the Lodz ghetto during WWII, believed cooperation with the Nazis could save lives, providing labor in exchange for food. This approach kept some semblance of community and culture alive amidst unimaginable horror.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpene Redder en Super-Valp / Valpene Redder Ryders Robot
programme.desc: Rubble later som han er superhvalp, men havner i trøbbel og må få hjelp av Ryder og Paw Patrol. // Ryders robotvalp går i stykker og lager kaos i Adventure-bukta, og Paw Patrol må hjelpe Ryder med å finne den.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpenes Banemannskap / Brannslukkende Valper

programme.title: iCarly: Fotsår reklame

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg lover å ikke sladre
programme.desc: Carly får en B på historieprøven hun burde ha fått en A på. Sam, som griper sjansen på sitt ukentlige møte med rektor Franklin, forandrer Carlys karakter på datamaskinen og overrasker henne med A blank.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly redder TV
programme.desc: En prestisjetung produsent vil gjøre iCarly om til et TV-show. Men Carly, Sam og Freddie blir raskt fortvilet når de hører om alle de store forandringene produsenten ønsker å foreta.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg hater Sams kjæreste
programme.desc: Sam får en kjæreste og de to blir uadskillelige. Men når forholdet begynner å få følger for iCarly, forstår Carly og Freddie at de må gjøre noe.

programme.title: iCarly: Overvåket
programme.desc: Etter å ha sett et klipp på iCarly der en mann selger illegale piratkopivideoer, bestemmer to detektiver seg for å bruke Carly og Spencers loft for overvåking.

programme.title: iCarly: Skolebytte
programme.desc: Carly får vite at hun får mulighet til å få et fullt stipend til en privat eliteskole pga nettshowet sitt. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i sterk tvil, men Sam og Freddie vet de må få henne til å gå for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fektedrama
programme.desc: Freddie trenger litt guttetid, så han slår seg sammen med Spencer for å dra og fekte. Freddie er et naturtalent, men ting blir innviklet når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mot den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: Vinn en date
programme.desc: Når vennen deres Gibby er for sjenert for å be ut jenta han liker, bestemmer gjengen seg for å gjøre ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" innslag på nettvideoshowet deres

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så han først

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Fungus Humungous

programme.desc: Når Donnie oppgraderer Metallhodes kunstige intelligens, må han bestemme seg for om han kan stole på det nye Metallhode....eller om han har skapt en ny fiende.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.desc: Ryder och Paw Patrol räddar en bortsprungen katt som drivit ut till havs men väl på land rymmer katten upp på stadshusets tak. // Efter ett stenras sitter Katie och Smulan fast på ett tåg på en gammal bro! Valparna måste snabbt få bort stenblocken.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar cirkusen / Kuckelikul med valparna
programme.desc: Ryder får ett samtal från cirkusdirektören. Det visar sig nämligen att elefanten Ellie har rymt från cirkuståget! // Borgmästare Rospiggs höna har försvunnit. Nu måste Ryder och Paw Patrol hitta Hönrietta igen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpar räddar en supervalp / Valpar räddar Ryders robot
programme.desc: Rubble låtsas att han är en supervalp, men när han hamnar i knipa måste Ryder och de andra valparna rädda honom! // När Ryder tappar kontrollen över sin nya robot krävs det att hela Paw Patrol hjälps åt för att hitta den igen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar Kaniner / Valptastisk
programme.desc: Bonden Yumis morötter försvinner och Paw Patrol hittar spår av kaniner. Nu måste de hitta dem och ge dem ett nytt hem. // Katie anmäler en av valparna till en husdjurstävling men Paw Patrol måste ut på uppdrag och Katie får en ny oväntad kandidat.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparnas Depåteam / Valparna Släcker Eld
programme.desc: Ryder och Paw Patrol måste rädda Alex när han drar iväg på sin nya super-trehjuling. Snart får valparna hjälpa honom att laga den. // Marshall visar vilken hjälte han är när han stannar och släcker en eld på stranden mitt under en pågående tävling.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar baddagen / Cirkusvalptister
programme.desc: Det är en riktigt varm dag, och valparna beger sig till vattenparken. Men poolen är tom! Nu måste Paw Patrol rädda dagen! // När cirkusdjuren inte dyker upp i tid måste Ryder och Paw Patrol ställa upp istället!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar Vilda Västern-festival / Valparna räddar Alex
programme.desc: En flock kossor bestämmer sig för att rymma från tågstationen under Äventyrbuktens Vilda Västern-festival. // När deras kompis Alex vill gå med i Paw Patrol låter Ryder och valparna honom följa med under en dag.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar Påskäggsjakten
programme.desc: I Äventyrsbukten är det dags för den årliga påskäggsjakten och valparna hjälper Borgmästare Rospigg att måla äggen. När Ryder och Paw Patrol letar efter ett specialägg hamnar de plötsligt mitt i ett spännande äventyr!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna och bönstjälken / Valparna räddar Piggvararna
programme.desc: Rubble tar sig en tupplur under ett träd, men väcks av att Äventyrsbukten fått besök av en jättestor Alex! // Kapten Piggvar och hans franska kusin försöker fotografera en sällsynt fågel, men det slutar med att de båda fastnar på en klippa!

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 405

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark
programme.desc: Anne Sofie och Paw har inte tillräckligt med utrymme i den lilla Frederiksberg-lägenheten efter en familjeökning. Men kraven på drömhuset är stora, även med 7 miljoner kommer det bli svårt...

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Episod 501
programme.desc: Louise och Jonas från Viborg drömmer stort, men drömmen faller till marken med en smäll. Experterna kallas in för extra arbete innan den lilla familjen - förhoppningsvis - flyttar in i sitt drömhus.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.desc: Efter att en båt läckt ut olja måste Ryder och valparna städa upp Äventyrsbukten och rädda alla djuren. // När Äventyrsbuktens berömda staty hamnar på buktens botten måste Ryder och valparna komma på ett smart sätt att få upp den igen!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar julen

programme.desc: Paw Patrol måste snabbt komma på ett sätt att laga den trasiga järnvägen innan nästa tåg kommer! // Ryder och Paw Patrol måste skynda sig och laga den trasiga fyren.

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet visar Stefan Idstam hur han tränar sina wedgar för bättre bollträff, längdkontroll och trygghet. Passet går från teknik till övningar som sedan omsätts i verkliga spelsituationer.

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: I avsnitt 4 av My Tour Routine visar Stefan Idstam hur han tränar inspel från 125 meter och längre genom uppvärmning, längdkontroll, spel med järnklubbor och hur du kan följa dina resultat utan launch monitor.

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: Närspel behöver inte vara svårt. Stefan Idstam visar sitt enkla system för chippar, pitchar och bunkerslag med samma uppställning och sving, där olika klubbor används för att styra höjd och längd.

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: Har du problem med treputtar? Stefan Idstam visar en enkel och upprepningsbar puttrutin med fokus på startriktning, korta puttar och längdkontroll. Passet tar under 30 minuter och kräver minimal utrustning.

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: Stefan Idstam bygger vidare på sitt närspelssystem med slag från ruff och längre bunkerslag. Med enkla justeringar fungerar systemet på olika underlag och passar golfare på alla nivåer.

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: Stefan Idstam delar sin mest genomarbetade puttrutin, utvecklad under många år som proffs. På en liten yta visar han ett utmanande träningspass för erfarna golfare som vill vässa hela sin puttning.

programme.title: Casual Golf
programme.desc: I den här videon spelas en full 18-håls match mellan Golfaraben och Abbegolf. Matchspel över en hel runda där varje hål räknas, med sjuka slag, nerviga puttar, banstrategi, snack, skratt och äkta tävlingsnerver ute på banan.

programme.title: The Birdcage

programme.title: Strange Love Of Martha IVers
programme.desc: Martha, Walter och Sam är för alltid bundna till varandra av en hemsk hemlighet. Flera år senare är Martha och Walter gifta. När Sam återvänder till staden och in i deras liv stiger spänningen.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: DEFIANCE är den otroliga men sanna historien om tre bröder som under andra världskriget står upp mot den tyska ockupationsmakten.

programme.title: Vanquish
programme.desc: Damon, ett pensionerat polisbefäl, kidnappar sin vårdare Victorias dotter. För att rädda sin dotter tvingas Victoria hjälpa Damon att lura hans korrupta kollegor i ett försök att rensa upp i stan innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Vault
programme.desc: Filmen utspelar sig 1975 och är inspirerad av den sanna historien om en grupp småbrottslingars försök att begå den största stöten i USA:s historia.

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Chloe, en ung kvinna som lever på gatan i New York, möter den vise inuiten Theo, som har skickats till New York av sina ”äldste” för att överlämna ett budskap till världen.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En erfaren lönnmördare får problem när han blir kär i sitt mål, en charmig svindlare som inte tänker gå ner utan en fight.

programme.title: The Upside of Anger
programme.desc: När den äkta maken plötsligt lämnar henne förvandlas Terrys liv till ett bittert helvete. Hon tillbringar dagarna med att svepa drinkar och få hysteriska utbrott på sina fyra döttrar.

programme.title: Boomerang: Pilot
programme.desc: Marknadsförarna Bryson Broyer och Simone Graham försöker hitta sina egna vägar till framgång och samtidigt vårda arvet från sina föräldrar, The Graham Agency, det en gång så ansedda företaget som nu har förlorat sin lyster.

programme.title: Boomerang: Game Night
programme.desc: Bryson har spelkväll med gänget, men svartsjukan spirar när Simone får upp ögonen för en oväntad gäst. Dessutom träffas David och Crystal för första gången sen skilsmässan.

programme.title: Boomerang: Power
programme.desc: Bryson försöker få Victoria att marknadsföra en svart avantgardefilm. Simone letar möjligheter för Tia att bygga upp sitt varumärke. Bryson tar tillbaka makten från Simone.

programme.title: Boomerang: Call A Spade
programme.desc: Simone, Crystal och Tia ger sig ut i natten för att rädda Simones gudsyster och hennes pojkvän från häktet. Simone brottas också med sina skuldkänslor över skilsmässan mellan Crystal och David.

programme.title: Games People Play: Pilot
programme.desc: Nia blir befordrad, flyttar till LA och lämnar sin pojkvän Eric i New York. Vanessa och hennes basketspelande make Marcus flyttar också till LA, och nyheten sprids att hans tidigare älskarinna nu är försvunnen.

programme.title: Games People Play: Lover's Moon
programme.desc: Nia intervjuar Laila som bekräftar att mannen på bilderna är Marcus King. Nia förvarnar Vanessa inför publiceringen. Kareem berättar för Marcus om de gamla spelarna och utpressningen.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Drink of Kings
programme.desc: Marcus och Vanessa går i parterapi. Nia och MJ försöker komma tillbaka efter förlusten av Laila-storyn. Laila börjar jobba på privata event för Roxanne och träffar Susie Q. Susie bjuder med Laila till ett stort gig.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Mixed Messages

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby

programme.desc: A drive-by shooting leaves one man dead and another seriously wounded. Cell phone calls and shell casings point to a suspect, but authorities are unable to place him at the crime scene. A forensic geologist proves that dirt is anything but dumb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Duelling Confessions
programme.desc: When Rosemary Anderson is found dead on the side of the road, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect. He eventually confessed to her murder, but so did another man: serial killer Eric Edgar Cooke.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Traces of Truth
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of employees' jobs. Forensic investigators must determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Curve
programme.desc: It was supposed to be a routine motorcade for the Queen of England. But on the way to Yosemite National Park, a car carrying three Secret Service agents collided with a car driven by a deputy from the local sheriff's office.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Visibility Zero
programme.desc: In 1993, the Amtrak Railroad experienced the deadliest train crash in United States history when the Sunset Limited derailed while crossing Alabama's Big Bayou Canot bridge. 47 passengers and crew were killed; scores more were injured.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Seeds of Destruction
programme.desc: Forensic Botany & Geology: Plants help provide oxygen and nutrients for existence. Soil is the fertilizer of life. Yet both can yield clues to the time and location of a person's death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder For Hire
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A brutal double murder shocks Northern California's peace-loving and laid back Marin County. With residents reeling, police chase an elusive killer through three counties and multiple crime scenes.

programme.title: The Accused: Episode 2
programme.desc: Lukasz is a banker accused of stealing thousands of pounds from one of his bank’s elderly customers. Lukasz denies the charges, but if he is found guilty, his life will change forever.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Bad Hair Day
programme.desc: Impaired driving leads to tragic results, a drunk finds religion and police investigate a road rage complaint.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Scandalous Murder of William Desmond Taylor

programme.title: City Confidential

programme.title: Auschwitz: The Nazis and the Final Solution
programme.desc: År 1943 härjar korruptionen på Auschwitz-Birkenau. Lägre får även en ny inkomstkälla – kläder och värdesaker som tas från judar som kommer för att gasa.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 606

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney reser till New York och förväntar sig att träffa Alex, men får i stället upp ögonen för Jay. Heidi är deppad över att ha fått sparken, men när Spencer går till Brent i ett försök att hjälpa henne få jobbet tillbaka gör han saken etter värre.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Episod 505

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 601
programme.desc: Nathja, Kristian och deras nyfödda dotter bor i en ombyggd butik med en lucka i sovrummet. Kristian drömmer om ett stort garage och Nathja vill hellre stanna i Køge - kan Tobias förverkliga deras drömmar?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 602
programme.desc: Maja och Kenneth bor i Västjylland och drömmer om att komma närmare Majas familj i Silkeborg. Men deras budget kräver att de kompromissar med platsen och letar i närliggande småstäder.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Gary blir svartsjuk när Marnie flirtar med den nya killen, Aaron. Alla blir glada när Vicky kommer tillbaka och de har sin första Tash-On Tours där geordisarna sätter sin egen tequila-dränkta prägel på singelkvällar.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Family's Reunited

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flashover
programme.desc: A fire erupts in Kings Cross Station in London, killing 31 people and injuring dozens more. Investigators pinpoint the cause of the fire, but it takes state-of-the-art technology and fluid dynamics experts to explain why it became a deadly inferno.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hack Attack
programme.desc: A mysterious computer crash pushed a thriving manufacturing company to the brink of collapse, jeopardizing hundreds of jobs. Forensic investigators had to determine if the crash was the result of a computer defect, human error, or sabotage.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Road Rage
programme.desc: Police investigate a discarded sleeping bag containing bloody sneakers and a purse, which eventually leads to the body of a young woman. A mark found on the victim's body enables police to track the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hunter or Hunted
programme.desc: A woman is killed while walking her dogs in the woods. Since she has no enemies and her husband has an alibi, police assume it's a hunting accident — until they find a strange letter, allegedly written by the woman before her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: An Alaskan police officer finds a woman's body while on routine patrol of a public park. During the autopsy, the medical examiner preserves the portion of her rib cage which sustained the fatal wound.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Corpus Delicti
programme.desc: A woman disappears without a trace. Even though foul play is suspected, the leads don't pan out and the trail turns cold. Twenty years would pass before police are able to link a clump of hair discovered in an isolated area with the missing woman.

programme.title: Forensic Files: News at 11
programme.desc: When a talented television news anchor is shot to death outside her home, it appears to be a crime of passion perpetrated by an obsessed fan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Burning Desire
programme.desc: Investigators sift through the ashes of a fire which killed a 40-year-old woman. The fire appears to have been started by an unattended cigarette. On closer look, forensic scientists discover the cause was far more complicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cloak of Deceit
programme.desc: For seven years, a trio of men robbed one bank after another. They always got away before the police arrived and they left no evidence behind. But the way they stood and the clothes they wore told a story that could be read by forensic scientists.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction

programme.title: Henry Danger: Hinkfällan
programme.desc: Henry och Charlotte vill berätta för Jasper att Henry egentligen är Kid Danger. De bestämmer sig för att sätta honom på prov för att se om han verkligen skulle klara av att hålla deras hemlighet säker.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry i Dåligt Sällskap 1
programme.desc: Ett graffitigäng härjar i Swellview, och Kid Danger ger sig ut för att leta rätt på deras ledare. Men han blir snabbt förtjust i en söt tjej i graffitigänget, och blir tvingad att välja sida en gång för alla.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry i Dåligt Sällskap 2
programme.desc: Kid Danger har gått över till den onda sidan och gått med i det graffitigäng som härjar i Swellview. Captain Man söker desperat över sin försvunna sidekick, och försöker hitta ett sätt att stoppa gängets ledare, Van Dal.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Flickvän
programme.desc: Jaspers flickvän kommer till staden på besök, och får sova över hemma hos Charlotte. Hon blir dock snabbt svartsjuk och blir övertygad om att Charlotte är kär i Jasper. Charlotte börjar undra om Jaspers flickvän har en skruv lös.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Takten Sitter I
programme.desc: Doktor Minyak är tillbaka, och den här gången sitter Henry verkligen i knipa! Doktor Minyak har nämligen förvandlat Charlotte till en jättestark varelse vars enda mål är att jaga rätt på Kid Danger och Captain Man.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Tjejer. Del 1
programme.desc: Samtidigt som han försöker få fast Galna Gumman, en gammal tant som terroriserat Captain Man på sistone, tvingas Henry försöka balansera arbetslivet med sitt kärleksliv.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Tjejer. Del 2
programme.desc: Henrys planer inför den stora skolfesten blir lite komplicerade när han även måste gå på festen som Kid Danger. När det sedan börjar köra ihop sig rejält på festen tvingas han ta ett drastiskt beslut.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry och Hackspettarna
programme.desc: När Pipers basketbollstränare slutar övertalar hon Henry att ta över tjänsten. Samtidigt som han försöker få laget i vinnarform tvingas han kämpa mot styrelsen för Swellviews Ungdoms-Rörelse, som är allt annat än förtjusta i hans metoder.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kapten Man på Semester
programme.desc: När Kapten Man blir inbjuden till sin kusins bröllop, lämnar han Swellview i Henry och Charlottes händer. Men det dyker snart upp problem när de tvingas ta hand om stadens problem helt själva.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsskojaren
programme.desc: När Kid Danger och Kapten Man möter Tidsskojaren, råkar Henry falla in i Tidsskojarens tidsmaskin, och tvingas återuppleva hela dagen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Saken är Biff
programme.desc: När han blir inbjuden till stadens mest exklusiva restaurang, bestämmer sig Henry för att ta med sig sin chef Ray dit. Men det hela blir betydligt mer komplicerat än vad Henry kunde ha anat.

programme.title: Apollos månfärder: Raketfeber

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programme.desc: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programme.title: Blaze och monstermaskinerna

programme.title: Dora Utforskaren

programme.title: Dora Utforskaren

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: iCarly: Jag älskar dej

programme.title: iCarly: iQ

programme.title: iCarly: iMöter rikets första dam

programme.title: iCarly: iTån och Fat Cakes

programme.title: iCarly: iSynproblem

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark
programme.desc: Musikern Lisbeth har alltid levt ett fritt liv och drömt om en karriär som YouTube-stjärna. Men nu har domslutet fallit! Lisbeth har fått sparken från sitt jobb och hennes fordringsägare vill ha sina pengar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Danmark

programme.desc: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Money Makin' Monster Machines
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes on the attack & ends up on a collision course with a hardened veteran auction buyer. They uncover a collection of speedy off-road vehicles and some hardcore heavy metal from the turn-of the-century!

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: När en gruva kollapsar i Kanada fångas en grupp gruvarbetare. Nu måste Jim hitta långtradarförare som kan transportera räddningsutrustning via farliga isvägar över frusna vatten innan det är för sent.

programme.title: Bronson
programme.desc: Charles Bronson, född Michael Peterson, är Englands mest våldsbenägne intern. Redan som barn drömde han om att bli berömd, men visste inte för vad tills den dagen han rånade ett postkontor.

programme.title: TAKEN
programme.desc: Bryan, en före detta CIA-agent har svårt att släppa sin gamla yrkesroll och ser faror överallt. När hans dotter, Kim, åker till Paris, besannas hans värsta mardröm, hon kidnappas.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Chanel and Sterling XCI
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av "Ridiculousness" får Rob, Chanel och Steelo lära sig om de som är "Gammal och arg", blir inspirerade av "Avancerad lättja" och flyger högt med "Himmel-killar".

programme.title: Teen Mom 2
programme.desc: Följ med på en nostalgitripp med Chelsea och Cole, och deras nära och kära. Vi tar en titt på deras förhållande, från allra första ögonkastet.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Dizzy Heights!
programme.desc: Geordisarna har fest i huset! Fullt ös och mycket hångel. Beau väljer Bethan stället för Abbie, vilket leder till att Chloe och Nathan blir osams - igen! Scott beslutar att lagandan måste stärkas, så de två får testa rappellering.

programme.title: Punk'd: Freddy Rodriguez, Molly Simms, Magic Johnson
programme.desc: Freddy Rodriguez finds himself with the wrong dog. Molly Simms car gets dumped on when a dumpster is emptied on it. Magic Johnson has a run in with the psycho ex.

programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: I detta nya avsnitt av 'Ridiculousness' försöker Rob, Chanel och Steelo att inte säga nåt fel i 'Irritationsmoment', hyllar pappor i 'Pappahelg' och visar att äldre inte alltid är klokare i 'Gamla dumskallar'.

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Catelynn och Tyler bestämde sig för att adoptera bort sitt barn och sen dess har kamerorna dokumenterat deras resa. I denna entimmesspecial återupplever de hudlösheten, de starka känslorna och allt som följde sen.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: Leona Lewis
programme.desc: Ikväll i "Ridiculousness får gänget sällskap av den platinasäljande sångerskan och låtskrivaren Leona Lewis för att se på "Affärstroll", hur man blir missförstådd när man "Talar leonesiska" och lär oss mer om att vara "Absolut brittisk".

programme.title: Ghabe
programme.desc: Den syriska flyktingen Monirär kastas in i den svenska urskogen där tiden står stilla. Moa, som är på en egen slags flykt, befinner sig också i skogen över sommaren. Är deras nyfikenhet för varandra starkare än rädslor och fördomar?

programme.title: Urban Cowboy
programme.desc: En lantis i västra Texas åker till storstaden där han rider en mekanisk tjur, träffar sin framtida fru och blir ovän med en f.d fånge.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: Amy Schumer spelar rollen som Renee, en ung kvinna som varje dag febrilt försöker övervinna sin osäkerhet och sin känsla av otillräcklighet.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Storfräsarna
programme.desc: Terence Hill och Bud Spencer får dubbelgångare. Tur att två av dem kan slåss! De rika kusinerna Antonio och Sebastiano är två brasilianska mångmiljonärer som lever i skräck för yrkesmördare. Därför anställer de två dubbelgångare.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Filmen berättar historien om Travis, en man vilse i sitt eget privata helvete. Förmodad död i fyra år, dyker han en dag upp i öknen, trött och med minnesförlust.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 517
programme.desc: Det är framdukat för en annorlunda vecka på Camp Kulinaris. Deltagarna kastas in i en stor utmaning, som skapar både glädje och frustration i köket.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 518
programme.desc: Trioveckan fortsätter på Camp Kulinaris. De tre lagen får äntligen veta vad de ska servera imorgon och stämningen försämras i köket.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 519
programme.desc: Det är serveringsdag på Camp Kulinaris. De tre lagen ska laga japanska rätter inför gästerna och det blå laget kämpar med samarbetet.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 520
programme.desc: Det är tävlingsdag på Camp Kulinaris. De två förlorande lagen från gårdagens servering får testa sitt samarbete i en kaotisk lärlingsmatch.

programme.title: Camp Kulinaris: Avsnitt 521
programme.desc: Det är en ny vecka på Camp Kulinaris. Veckans tema väcker stor entusiasm hos en av deltagarna. En strikt regim införs i köket.

programme.title: Skönhetsfällan Danmark: Avsnitt 306

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Bli Knasig
programme.desc: En komet gör att Thundermans krafter blir knasiga samtidigt som killen Phoebe är kär i bjuder henne på skoldansen. Phoebe och Max får veta att om de håller ihop kan de hålla sina krafter i styr, men ingen är speciellt glad för att ha den andra nära.

programme.title: Familjen Thunderman: Objudna Restauranggäster
programme.desc: När ungarna råkar krascha presenten som Hank köpt till Barb på deras bröllopsdag, måste de ta hjälp av Blobbin, en vän till familjen och superhjältemedhjälpare, för att laga den och se till att deras föräldrar inte får reda på nåt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: When the body of a young woman is found under an isolated highway ramp, a unique fiber on the victim's clothing leads San Diego police straight to the most unlikely of killers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Matrimony
programme.desc: A go-go dancer told her family she needed to get away for a while and then she simply disappeared. Investigators were suspicious, because she took neither her car nor her clothes. 20 years later, her family received a call that changed everything.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muddy Waters
programme.desc: A Colorado hunter is the victim of a well-planned crime. Investigators suspect two weapons and two killers. But forensic evidence points them in a different direction — one much closer to home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Point of Origin
programme.desc: In 1984, California firefighters battled ten arson fires in three weeks. When cigarettes and a scrap of paper connected the case to similar fires further north, the hunt was on for a dangerous pyromaniac.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Alaskan hikers discover a body wrapped in sheets which were edged in orange stitching. Investigators find a tuft of red carpet fibers clinging to the sheet — threads of evidence which lead them straight to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Booze Recovery Team
programme.desc: Police investigate a theft of alcohol, a man with a knife takes hostages and sports car leads police on a high-speed chase.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Teenagers stumble across a horrifying car fire on the side of a desolate stretch of roadway. When the police arrive, they pull severely burned human remains from the driver’s seat.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Bette Lucas, the most popular philanthropist in the wealthy town of Tyler, Texas, dies mysteriously and her son Steven is accused of murder.

programme.title: True Nordic Crimes: Night Horrors
programme.desc: A woman asleep in her living room is brutally attacked with a hammer in the middle of the night. Even though one of her daughter witnesses the attack through a glass door she can't help her screaming mother because the perpetrator locked the doors.

programme.title: Under Arrest: Nightmare
programme.desc: A domestic dispute turns violent, an armed car thief is apprehended and shots are fired outside a nightclub.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Rochdale Groomers
programme.desc: Rochdale Groomers: Documentary examining the sex abuse scandal which occurred in the North of England and appeared to go undetected for quite some time.

programme.title: Women Behind Bars

programme.desc: Kapten Piggvar krockar med en klippa och nu måste Paw Patrol laga hans båt och rädda honom, men en av valparna tar sig vatten över huvudet. // Paw Patrol kämpar för att rädda bondens Yumis grödor när en snöstorm dragit in lagom till höstfestivalen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Vaplarna Dansar Fyrhusboogie / Valparna Räddar Ryder
programme.desc: Borgmästare Rospigg och Alex ror ut till havs för att titta på en val. Plötsligt drar en storm in och Paw Patrol måste rädda dem från vågorna. // Ryder försöker rädda en geten från en klippa men fastnar. Han ringer Paw Patrol men tappar sin Valp-pad!

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna och katt-astrofen / Valparna räddar ett tåg
programme.desc: Ryder och Paw Patrol räddar en bortsprungen katt som drivit ut till havs men väl på land rymmer katten upp på stadshusets tak. // Efter ett stenras sitter Katie och Smulan fast på ett tåg på en gammal bro! Valparna måste snabbt få bort stenblocken.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar cirkusen / Kuckelikul med valparna
programme.desc: Ryder får ett samtal från cirkusdirektören. Det visar sig nämligen att elefanten Ellie har rymt från cirkuståget! // Borgmästare Rospiggs höna har försvunnit. Nu måste Ryder och Paw Patrol hitta Hönrietta igen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valpar räddar en supervalp / Valpar räddar Ryders robot
programme.desc: Rubble låtsas att han är en supervalp, men när han hamnar i knipa måste Ryder och de andra valparna rädda honom! // När Ryder tappar kontrollen över sin nya robot krävs det att hela Paw Patrol hjälps åt för att hitta den igen.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar Kaniner / Valptastisk
programme.desc: Bonden Yumis morötter försvinner och Paw Patrol hittar spår av kaniner. Nu måste de hitta dem och ge dem ett nytt hem. // Katie anmäler en av valparna till en husdjurstävling men Paw Patrol måste ut på uppdrag och Katie får en ny oväntad kandidat.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparnas Depåteam / Valparna Släcker Eld
programme.desc: Ryder och Paw Patrol måste rädda Alex när han drar iväg på sin nya super-trehjuling. Snart får valparna hjälpa honom att laga den. // Marshall visar vilken hjälte han är när han stannar och släcker en eld på stranden mitt under en pågående tävling.

programme.title: PAW Patrol: Valparna räddar baddagen / Cirkusvalptister
programme.desc: Det är en riktigt varm dag, och valparna beger sig till vattenparken. Men poolen är tom! Nu måste Paw Patrol rädda dagen! // När cirkusdjuren inte dyker upp i tid måste Ryder och Paw Patrol ställa upp istället!

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In 1967, 75-year-old widow Louisa Dunne was raped and strangled in her Bristol home. The case remained unsolved for 57 years until DNA evidence led to the 2025 conviction of 92-year-old Ryland Headley.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 1999, 28-year-old Meekiah Wadley was bound and smothered in her Richmond, CA home, leaving her infant daughter behind. The cold case was finally solved 22 years later through familial DNA technology.

programme.title: Gabulosis: A Summer Boy Scout Trip That Turned Into a Decades Long Mystery: What Happened to Garrett Bardsley?
programme.desc: On August 20, 2004 Garrett Bardsley told his father he was going to walk back to camp to change his clothes after falling in the water while they were fishing. He was never seen again and no clues have ever surfaced.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The Tragic Case of the Boy in the Bundle

programme.title: White Christmas
programme.desc: Two talented son-and-dance men (Bing Crosby and Danny Kaye) team up after the war to become one of the hottest acts in show business.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments (1956)
programme.desc: Raised as an Egyptian prince, Moses (Charlton Heston) discovers his Hebrew heritage, hears God's call, and engages in a bitter battle with the Pharaoh Ramses (Yul Brynner) to free the Jews from slavery, leading them to the Promised Land.

programme.title: Samson and Delilah
programme.desc: The glorious epic style of Cecil B. DeMille is exemplified in this story of the Bible's legendary strongman and the woman who seduces, then betrays him.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his IMF team embark on their most dangerous mission yet: To track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity before it falls into the hands of a mysterious, all-powerful enemy.

programme.title: The Rock
programme.desc: A weapons expert and a prisoner join forces to avert a catastrophe.

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: In 1776, South Carolina widower and legendary war hero Benjamin Martin (Mel Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family torn apart by the savage British Redcoats.

programme.title: Deep Blue Sea
programme.desc: One of nature's most perfect killing machines has been re-engineered as something smarter, faster, and deadlier. When things go wrong, the aquatic killing machines begin hunting their creators, who are alone and adrift on the Deep Blue Sea.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety, but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn 2: Texas Blood Money
programme.desc: When a gang of bank robbers makes a run for the border, they wander into the wrong bar and mess with the wrong vampires. It's kill-or-be-killed in the ultimate battle to stop these evil creatures and save their own lives!

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Winner of 2 Academy Awards, including Best Original Screenplay. With the help of his mentor, a slave-turned-bounty hunter sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

programme.title: Swordsman II [English Subtitled]
programme.desc: Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.

programme.title: Supercop (1996)
programme.desc: Jackie Chan, Michelle Yeoh, and Maggie Cheung lead an action-packed classic with jaw-dropping stunts, from leaping out a ten-story building onto an airborne helicopter to landing on top of a speeding train.

programme.title: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Wing Chun, a talented martial artist, decides to fight against horse thieves in the village to receive respect from the villagers.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: A tough cop must pose as a kindergarten teacher to locate a dangerous criminal's ex-wife, who may hold the key to putting him behind bars.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Role Models
programme.desc: The world's least likely mentors must set aside their selfish ways to impart invaluable wisdom to two kids about life, love, and heavy metal.

programme.title: This Is 40
programme.desc: From the director of Knocked Up comes a comedic look at an American family as one couple (Paul Rudd and Leslie Mann) tries to balance romance, parenting, and children in their own hilarious ways.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Meet Tibby, Bridget, Lena and Carmen—four teenage best friends who share a pair of secondhand jeans as a unique way of staying connected while separated during a pivotal point in their lives—the summer of their 16th birthdays.

programme.title: Body of Lies
programme.desc: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

programme.title: The Fugitive
programme.desc: Harrison Ford stars as the wrongly convicted Dr. Richard Kimble, and Tommy Lee Jones is U.S. Marshal Sam Gerard, his relentless pursuer, in this intense thriller based on the hit television series of the 1960s.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Jerry Maguire is a sports agent who reaches a crisis point in his life when he decides to become an honorable man. Follow his journey to redemption through an unlikely alliance with a female accountant, and his least important client.

programme.title: A Star Is Born (2018)
programme.desc: In this new take on the tragic love story, musician Jackson Maine discovers—and falls in love with—struggling artist Ally. But even as Ally's career takes off, their relationship is breaking down.

programme.title: American Hustle
programme.desc: The con is on when scam artists and lovers Irving Rosenfeld and Sydney Prosser are entrapped by ambitious FBI agent Richie DiMaso and coerced into participating in a sting operation that hinges on snaring politician Carmine Polito and his associates.

programme.title: Lawless
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf, Tom Hardy, and Jessica Chastain star in this adaptation of 'The Wettest County in the World.' A bootlegging gang make a run for the American Dream during Prohibition.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Winners of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which the irresistible stolen loot from a crime scene sets off an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: Infinite
programme.desc: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves Infinites come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and an all-star cast reunite in this action-packed adventure where an accursed mummy is resurrected – along with a force even more powerful: The Scorpion King (The Rock).

programme.title: Déjà Vu
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: If you thought it was just a trick of the mind, prepare yourself for the truth.

programme.title: The Wasp
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: This thriller follows Heather and Carla, who meet after not having spoken in years. Heather is about to present a very unexpected proposition that could change their lives forever.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams: the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends are holed up in a remote cabin, where they discover a Book Of The Dead. They unwittingly summon demons living in the nearby woods, which in turn possess the youngsters until only one remains intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: A soft-spoken Vietnam vet drifts into a small town looking for no trouble, but finds it in the form of a psychotic local sheriff who finds pleasure in hating him for no reason.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is sent on an assignment back to Southeast Asia to uncover evidence of still missing POWs, and ends up with his hands full when he comes up against Vietnamese soldiers still guarding the camps.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: Jada Pinkett, Queen Latifah, Vivica A. Fox and Kimberly Elise star as four African American women living in a Los Angeles housing project who--pushed to the edge--resort to violence to escape poverty.

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After being released from prison, Leo Handler (Mark Wahlberg) takes a job with his powerfully influential Uncle Frank (James Caan). Leo soon finds himself unwittingly drawn into a world of sabotage, high-stakes payoffs and even murder.

programme.title: The Immigrant
programme.desc: Marion Cotillard, Joaquin Phoenix, and Jeremy Renner star in the story of Ewa, a recent immigrant to America who falls prey to a charming but wicked man who forces her into prostitution.

programme.title: Real Genius
programme.desc: When a group of crazy college geniuses puts their heads together, almost anything can happen. Hold on for a freewheeling, uproarious look at just how much mischief a bunch of high-IQers can concoct. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: Go
programme.desc: Ronna needs to make some extra cash. Simon wants to escape to Vegas for the weekend. Adam and Zack want to stay out of trouble. But it's not just another night in the life of these unusual characters.

programme.title: Go
programme.desc: Ronna needs to make some extra cash. Simon wants to escape to Vegas for the weekend. Adam and Zack want to stay out of trouble. But it's not just another night in the life of these unusual characters.

programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: A bad-tempered hockey player takes his talent to the golf course to win a tournament prize and save his grandmother's house from the IRS.

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
